argument_macro_structure.premise_explicitness: Moderate - premises are often embedded in phenomenological descriptions rather than formal propositions

distinctions_drawn: Word of the world vs. word of life

Henry's word of life risks becoming solipsistic and cut off from intersubjective world

summary_of_core_decisions: The text resolves the tension between finite cognition and infinite donation by redefining the subject as a witness, shifting from conditions of possibility to conditions of receptivity.

thesis_commitment.hedging_density_in_final_paragraph: Low - asserts the thesis as necessary and paradigmatic
